title: Hypno-Fermentation; Brain Goo Formation
description:
Hello, my little dummies!
This is one of the shortest full-session files I’ve ever made, but don’t let that fool you! It’s compact and immensely potent, with a trigger which offers unlimited fun! There are some passive suggestions of submission and arousal, but the main attraction is the loss of intelligence. The loss of thought. The loss of your brain to the fermentation process as the goo leaves you empty, blank, and stupid. You idiot.
There are no permanent suggestions here and the trigger is safely tucked away behind the stipulation that only I or someone you trust can break your brain in half…with goo. It’s just a fun little file!
You can read the full script if you’d like for more spoilers.
Now go be dumb!
It’s fun!
